d-fine-p51.title: Specification — Dissolution test only

Halcyon Ridge Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
400 Larkspur Way, Suite 12, Fictionville, NJ 08000, USA

Date: [date of dispatch]

Re: NDA 299001 - Ostrevia (lumiravostat) tablet, film-coated, 10 mg and 25 mg
eCTD sequence 0000 - original-application / application

Dear Review Division,

Halcyon Ridge Pharmaceuticals, Inc. submits this original New Drug Application for Ostrevia (lumiravostat) tablet, film-coated, 10 mg and 25 mg, proposed for the treatment of adults with moderate-to-severe chronic hand eczema inadequately controlled with topical corticosteroids.

The application is provided in eCTD format (v3.2.2) and contains Modules 1 to 5. The user fee coversheet (Form FDA 3397) is included in Module 1.1.

Contact: Dana Okafor, Director, Regulatory Affairs, +1 555 0100 220, regulatory@halcyonridge.example

Sincerely,

Dana Okafor, Director, Regulatory Affairs

TRAINING ONLY - fictional product and company, not for submission.
